modules.name: Privacy Weather
modules.summary: Zero-telemetry live weather, radar, and hourly forecast from Open-Meteo.
modules.description: Comprehensive weather card with temperature, feels-like, humidity, wind speeds, and hourly forecast from Open-Meteo with no user tracking. Supports location search by address/zip and optional GPS location access.
modules.author: RPDevs

configFields.label: Location Name
configFields.description: City / Region display name.

configFields.label: Latitude
configFields.description: Latitude coordinate.

configFields.label: Longitude
configFields.description: Longitude coordinate.

configFields.label: Use Fahrenheit (°F)
configFields.description: Toggle between Celsius and Fahrenheit units.

modules.name: Hardware & Battery Telemetry
modules.summary: Real-time battery charging wattage, voltage, temperature, internal storage, and RAM memory pressure.
modules.description: Live device diagnostics card displaying real-time battery percentage, charging wattage, battery temperature, RAM usage, and available internal disk storage.
modules.author: RPDevs

modules.name: Calendar Agenda
modules.summary: On-device agenda engine querying your upcoming 24-hour schedule.
modules.description: Displays upcoming calendar events from on-device Android calendars with zero telemetry. Automatically highlights all-day events and provides 1-tap navigation to the default calendar app.
modules.author: RPDevs

configFields.label: Lookahead Window (Hours)
configFields.description: How many hours in the future to scan for calendar events.

configFields.label: Show All-Day Events
configFields.description: Include full-day events in the agenda timeline.

modules.name: GitHub Pulse
modules.summary: Live GitHub PR review requests, workflow CI runs, assigned issues, and commit activity.
modules.description: Connects to the GitHub API via personal access token to track open pull requests, continuous integration workflow results across your repositories, and unread notifications.
modules.author: RPDevs

configFields.label: GitHub Username / Org
configFields.description: GitHub username or organization to track.

configFields.label: GitHub Personal Access Token
configFields.description: GitHub PAT with repo and notifications read permissions.

configFields.label: Tracked Repositories (owner/repo)
configFields.description: Comma-separated list of GitHub repositories to query for CI workflows.

modules.name: Webpage Monitor & Keyword Scraper
modules.summary: Scrape websites, track content changes via MD5 hash diffs, and monitor specific keywords or alerts.
modules.description: Periodic HTML scraping engine using Jsoup. Monitors target URLs for content modifications or specific keyword appearances, displaying alerts and direct links in the feed.
modules.author: RPDevs

configFields.label: Target Webpage URL
configFields.description: The URL of the webpage to scrape and monitor.

configFields.label: Monitored Keywords (comma-separated)
configFields.description: Keywords that trigger an alert when detected in the scraped HTML.

configFields.label: CSS Selector (Optional)
configFields.description: Optional CSS selector to scope content extraction (e.g., 'article' or 'div.posts').

configFields.label: Card Display Title
configFields.description: Title shown on the Hub feed card.

modules.name: Custom REST / JSON Endpoint
modules.summary: Poll arbitrary HTTP JSON APIs (Home Assistant, Uptime Kuma, Gotify, Docker) and render as cards.
modules.description: Declarative JSON REST client that executes periodic HTTP GET requests with custom headers, extracting JSON keys using dot-notation into chips, status badges, and timeline items.
modules.author: RPDevs

configFields.label: REST Endpoint URL
configFields.description: HTTP/HTTPS URL returning JSON or plain text.

configFields.label: Authorization Header (Optional)
configFields.description: Bearer token or API Key (e.g. 'Bearer token123').

configFields.label: JSON Path for Title / Message
configFields.description: JSON field path for card message (e.g. 'status', 'summary', or 'message').

configFields.label: Module Title
configFields.description: Card title to display on feed.

modules.name: Home Assistant State Monitor
modules.summary: Display smart home entity states, temperature sensors, lights, and climate controls.
modules.description: Integrates with Home Assistant REST API to display real-time sensor states, presence detection, and environment telemetry directly in the RPDev Feed.
modules.author: RPDevs

configFields.label: Home Assistant Base URL
configFields.description: URL of your local or remote Home Assistant instance.

configFields.label: Long-Lived Access Token
configFields.description: Long-lived access token generated from Home Assistant profile.

configFields.label: Entity IDs (comma-separated)
configFields.description: Home Assistant entity IDs to track.

modules.name: Docker & Fleet Health Monitor
modules.summary: Track container statuses, CPU/memory consumption, and uptime across host nodes.
modules.description: Polls Docker daemon or Portainer API endpoints to display active container counts, failed health checks, and server load metrics.
modules.author: RPDevs

configFields.label: Portainer / Docker API URL
configFields.description: REST API endpoint returning Docker container list JSON.

configFields.label: API Key / Token
configFields.description: Portainer API Token or proxy bearer token.

modules.name: Uptime Kuma Status Monitor
modules.summary: Monitor service uptime, response latencies, and incident status from Uptime Kuma.
modules.description: Fetches service status pages and heartbeat data from self-hosted Uptime Kuma monitoring instances.
modules.author: RPDevs

configFields.label: Uptime Kuma Status Page URL
configFields.description: Heartbeat or metrics API endpoint from Uptime Kuma.
